exact_title: Post-Integration Convergence, Canonical Entry-Surface Parity, and Mutation Acceptance Closure
primary_objective: Plan the convergence and entry-surface parity of Direct Core, Unified Ingress, and Canonical CLI across the accepted closed mutation operation set (plan_init, plan_retirement), verifying authorization-bound complete identity, multi-domain precondition enforcement, at-most-one execution, verify-after-write, durable recovery, and strict 3-way parity with zero semantic drift, zero new semantic operations, and zero cross-authority atomicity claims, while mapping historical regressions and preparing handoff to M4-R.
prerequisites: Accepted and integrated M4-6 + M4-7 known-good checkpoint 76b89a8cf73c8b6f690e5cb74ebe8900cc101dde (with review evidence 0224cdbb99d479f152e180633479db6a61dec73d), satisfying M4 DAG M4-6+M4-7 -> M4-8.
owns: Entry-surface convergence and parity (Direct Core, Unified Ingress, CLI) for plan_init and plan_retirement; end-to-end mechanical mutation flow; CLI mutation argument and output projection; result/error envelope convergence; authorization-bound complete identity convergence; successor/retirement regression map; historical regression mapping (Issue #8 and Issue #9); inherited fixture-debt and historical guard dispositions; M4-R handoff specification.
does_not_own: New semantic operations; new semantic authority; CLI exclusive entrypoint/generic terminal/Git write/GitHub API; cross-authority atomic transactions; production storage engine freezing; M5 runtime/Hermes dispatch/deployment execution; M4-R implementation or completion; production Issue #9 mutations.

recovered_authority_rules.principle: LLM is the semantic actor; Forge Core is executor-neutral; Unified Control Plane is deterministic/mechanical.
recovered_authority_rules.enforcement: No mechanical component (Core, Ingress, CLI, Port, Adapter, Journal) may make semantic choices.

recovered_authority_rules.principle: CLI is canonical machine adapter only, not exclusive entrypoint or semantic engine.
recovered_authority_rules.enforcement: Direct Core and Unified Ingress remain fully supported first-class entry surfaces with 0 semantic authority delta.

recovered_authority_rules.principle: GitHub is an external authority adapter, not Core ontology or semantic authority.
recovered_authority_rules.enforcement: Core contracts never reference GitHub API primitives; GitHub adapter is isolated behind PlanAuthorityMutationPort.

recovered_authority_rules.principle: Cross-authority atomic transactions are not available.
recovered_authority_rules.enforcement: Subject graph CAS and external authority writes are separate mechanical steps; atomicity is never claimed across boundaries.
Durable journal is an abstract port; file-backed adapter is reference/test-only, never frozen as production engine.
Exactly plan_init and plan_retirement are accepted writable operations in M4; zero new semantic operations allowed.
Subject revision CAS, authority source revision token, observed raw digest, candidate raw digest, and normalized plan digest are distinct domains.
Idempotency key alone is not complete identity; full semantic and authority context is bound to prevent replay on changed auth.
External writes require precondition verification before write and mandatory readback re-verification after write.
UNKNOWN_OUTCOME or RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT do not grant automatic retry authority; a fresh CapabilityLease is required.
